definitions.explanation: The state of having an empty stomach and feeling hungry. A more formal or objective way to describe hunger compared to the casual お{腹|なか}が{空|す}いた.

examples.japanese: {空腹|くうふく}のまま{勉強|べんきょう}するのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to study on an empty stomach.

examples.japanese: {空腹|くうふく}を{満|み}たすために{何|なに}か{食|た}べよう。
examples.english: Let's eat something to satisfy our hunger.

examples.japanese: {空腹|くうふく}{時|じ}に{薬|くすり}を{飲|の}まないでください。
examples.english: Please don't take this medicine on an empty stomach.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
・{空|くう} (empty) + {腹|ふく} (stomach/belly)

RELATED TERMS:
・{満腹|まんぷく} (full stomach) - antonym
・お{腹|なか}が{空|す}いた (I'm hungry - casual)
・{腹|はら}ペコ (starving - very casual)
・{飢餓|きが} (starvation - extreme hunger)
・{飢|う}える (to starve)

USAGE CONTEXTS:
・Medical: {空腹|くうふく}{時|じ} (on an empty stomach - for medicine instructions)
・Formal writing/speech
・Scientific/health discussions

EXPRESSIONS:
・{空腹|くうふく}は{最高|さいこう}の{調味料|ちょうみりょう} (Hunger is the best seasoning)
・{空腹|くうふく}に{耐|た}える (to endure hunger)

MEDICAL CONTEXT:
・{空腹|くうふく}{時|じ}{血糖値|けっとうち} (fasting blood sugar)
・{空腹|くうふく}{時|じ}に{服用|ふくよう} (take on empty stomach)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{空腹|くうふく}を{感|かん}じる (to feel hungry)
・{空腹|くうふく}を{満|み}たす (to satisfy hunger)
・{空腹|くうふく}{状態|じょうたい} (state of hunger)
